title_zh: GPT-4V(ision) 是通用网页智能体——前提是能够落地(接地)
one_line: SeeAct splits GPT-4V web acting into screenshot-based action generation and separate element grounding; offline Mind2Web plus a small live-website check show grounding is the bottleneck.
one_line_zh: SeeAct 将 GPT-4V 网页操作拆为截图规划与元素接地两步，离线 Mind2Web 与在线评测显示接地是瓶颈。

title_zh: WebVoyager：基于大型多模态模型构建端到端网页智能体
one_line: GPT-4V agent acts on live websites via Set-of-Mark-labelled element screenshots; human-judged live success beats text-only and GPT-4 All Tools; GPT-4V evaluator validated against humans.
one_line_zh: 用带数字标注的网页截图让GPT-4V在真实网站上端到端操作，人工评估在线成功率优于纯文本基线，并验证GPT-4V自动评估器。

title_zh: AndroidWorld：面向自主智能体的动态基准测试环境
one_line: Android benchmark of 116 parameterized tasks across 20 apps, rewarded by checkers reading system state via adb; zero-shot M3A/SeeAct online baselines, single run.
one_line_zh: 在20个真实安卓应用上构建116个参数化任务，用adb读取系统状态给出可执行奖励，并以M3A等零样本智能体做在线基线。

title_zh: OS-ATLAS：面向通用GUI智能体的基础动作模型
one_line: Synthesises 13M cross-platform grounding elements from HTML/A11y trees plus a unified action space to train a screenshot grounder/action model; evidence mostly ScreenSpot and offline step metrics, one OSWorld check.
one_line_zh: 从HTML/无障碍树跨平台合成1300万定位样本并统一动作空间训练截图定位/动作模型；证据主要为离线指标，仅一项OSWorld在线测试。

title_zh: ShowUI：面向GUI视觉智能体的统一视觉-语言-动作模型
one_line: Single 2B VLA grounder/navigator: UI-graph token selection, interleaved vision-action history, curated data; evidence mostly offline ScreenSpot/AITW/Mind2Web plus small MiniWob online check.
one_line_zh: 2B端到端VLA模型，用UI连通图做视觉token选择、交错视觉-动作历史与精选数据；证据以离线基准为主，仅MiniWob小规模在线验证。
